notes: HR reference data for Congolese companies (docs/modules/hr.md HR-03, HR-12, HR-13): identifier types and statutory leave types. Each row has a status (ResearchStatus): 'researched' values come from public research (docs/country-packs-research-2026-10.md) with their confidence, research date and sources; they are used, and leave records that use them say so until the owner confirms them through a pack release (ADM-04). 'assumed' lists fields that are defaults pending confirmation (maternity: paid, while the pay rate, 2/3 cited, is unconfirmed). A null pattern enforces no format; a null days value makes the leave type 'Days needed' (requests and accrual refused) until a tenant confirms it. Low-confidence research is never entered. events: per-event days within the type's yearly days (circumstantial leave: at most 10 working days a year, not deducted from annual leave, Code du travail art. 146). Labels live in lang/{locale}/hr.php (pack.*).
todo: Confirm every researched value, then publish it as confirmed through a pack release (ADM-04): maternity 14 weeks (98 calendar days) and circumstantial leave (10 working days a year; own marriage 2, birth of a child 2).
maternity: the pay during maternity leave (2/3 of pay is cited, low confidence). Until confirmed the type is marked paid (assumed) and payroll pays it in full: check each case.
annual: statutory annual leave (1.5 working days a month, or a 15/18/21-day seniority scale, are cited; low confidence), with the effective date.
sick: statutory sick leave (incapacité de travail) rules and pay (not found).
circumstantial: the other events (death of a spouse, child or parent, and so on) and their days, with legal references.
national_id and cnss_number: no reliable format found; not enforced.
